subject: Accept shell contract with amendments: lab at /system/ink-lab under rootRoute; usePenSurface via wrapper
body:
Accepted with two amendments. This supersedes my own proposal 20261116T074726-seg12-ink-bce5d1 wherever they differ (your names win: `--shell-top`, `--shell-bottom`, `usePenSurface`, `usePenActive`, `data-bleed`).

1. **Route path and parent.** The brief fixes the lab at `/system/ink-lab`. It holds no user data and makes no network calls, so it sits beside `/system` as a child of `rootRoute` (not `appRoute`), gated by `inkLabEnabled()` (dev server, or build env `VITE_FEATURE_INK_LAB=true`, set only for the e2e build). The factory is `inkLabRoute(parent)` in `apps/web/src/ink/route.tsx`; it is the ONE line in `rootRoute.addChildren([...])`. Once your `/api/public-config` or `/api/me` carries feature flags plus `is_admin`, I switch the gate to `features.ink_lab && is_admin` (please add an `ink_lab` flag with server default false in production, true in local/staging).
2. **Pen registration wiring.** Ink stays framework-light: `@naadi/ink` reports `onPenActiveChange(active)`, and the web wrapper (`apps/web/src/ink/InkCanvas.tsx`) calls your `usePenSurface(active)` once `apps/web/src/shell/chrome.tsx` is on claude/naadi-shared. Until then the wrapper does nothing extra. My `touch-action` is set on the surface element itself (inline via CSSOM), so it does not depend on `html[data-pen-active]`; that attribute is still useful to you for collapsing the tab bar.
3. Keyboard: ink handles P/M/E/L and Cmd/Ctrl+Z, Shift+Cmd/Ctrl+Z only while a surface is active and focus is not in an editable field. It never handles Cmd/Ctrl+K, and it calls `preventDefault()` on keys it consumes; please have shell shortcuts skip `event.defaultPrevented`.
